scripts.build: npm run build -w @swarmwatch/core && npm run build -w @swarmwatch/bridge && npm run build -w @swarmwatch/server && npm run build -w @swarmwatch/vite-plugin && npm run build -w swarmwatch && npm run build -w @swarmwatch/dashboard
scripts.dev: node packages/cli/dist/index.js watch --project examples/react-app --url http://127.0.0.1:5173 -- npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/bridge/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vite-plugin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.demo: node packages/cli/dist/index.js watch --demo --project examples/react-app --url http://127.0.0.1:5173 -- npm run dev
scripts.demo:plain: node packages/cli/dist/index.js watch --demo --project examples/plain-app --url http://127.0.0.1:5180 -- npm run dev
